description:
Laria, the leader of the Golden Deer Knights of Nixia.  
She leaves to find the Crown Prince Bolonis, who was falsely accused and exiled.  
With the help of a mysterious sorcerer, she comes to Korea where Crown Prince Jo is.

Laria meets Volonis, who has lost her memory, but  
She is enchanted and, under certain conditions, becomes a dog. She becomes a human being.

While going through the case of targeting the crown prince and various difficulties,  
Unknown from Nyxia, she slowly comes to know the Crown Prince's heart.

She wonders if she can get back to Nyxia safely with the Crown Prince and clear him of his name. (MTL)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://m.comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=794192), [Naver Series](https://m.series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8365482)
